title: Regular Expressions: Regexes in Python (Part 1)
description: Learn regex matching in Python with re.search(), and use metacharacters, groups, lookarounds, and flags to find complex patterns in strings.
summary: In this tutorial, you’ll explore regular expressions , also known as regexes , in Python. A regex is a special sequence of characters that defines a pattern for complex string-matching functionality.
takeaways: You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz Regular Expressions: Regexes in Python (Part 1) Test your understanding of Python regular expressions: the re module, character classes, anchors, groups, alternation, and flags.
Python, Java , and Perl all support regex functionality, as do most Unix tools and many text editors.
Earlier in this series, in the tutorial Strings and Character Data in Python , you learned how to define and manipulate string objects .
